|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is the current text. The image is the Players Committee printing of this version ([[:File:V4-L-solo-2022-06-01.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC printing (card image or errata sheet slip); card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later), slip dates are the errata sheet's PDF date. Every visibly different printing is a separate version, and an errata sheet slip is a version of its own, separate from the card image of the same errata (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V4-L-solo-2022-06-01-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V4-L-solo-2018-07-08.gif]], 8 July 2018) → [[File:V4-L-solo-2022-06-01-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V4-L-solo-2022-06-01.gif]], 1 June 2022). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints no errata mark, but this is errata 1 in release order; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Solo]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-solo022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/solo.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual4-Light/large/solo.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “•Smuggler’s Blues”. Text: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Deploys -1 to Falcon. Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Adds one battle destiny if with Chewie or Rey. Once per game, may play an Interrupt from Lost Pile as if from hand (then place that card out of play).”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 1 June 2022<ref name="img-soloe8445f0">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/solo.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26 commit e8445f0] (1 June 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual4-Light/large/solo.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the bottom margin “•Smuggler’s Blues” → “Smuggler’s Blues” (uniqueness dot removed); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Smuggler’s Blues”. It is the current image. Text: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Deploys -1 to Falcon. Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Adds one battle destiny if with Chewie or Rey. Once per game, may play an Interrupt from Lost Pile as if from hand (then place that card out of play).”
